posts.text:
Had a great discussion tonight with the Flagler County REC on lowering costs for Florida families, working together with law enforcement to keep our communities safe, and more. 

Together, we will keep Florida RED! 🇺🇸

Great public safety roundtable in Brevard County today with law enforcement and first responders.

As Governor, I’ll ensure law enforcement has our full support and every tool they need to do their job. 

Florida will be a zero-tolerance state for illegal immigration. We will always put the safety of our citizens first!
Great day in Brevard County with Sheriff Wayne Ivey!

Had a great meeting today with the Veterans of The Villages! 

Thank you to all our veterans for your courage, commitment, and sacrifice to our nation. 🇺🇸

Today, we launched the Defending the Florida Dream Tour in The Villages with a discussion on affordability.

As governor, I’ll take on rising healthcare costs head-on by increasing transparency, expanding choice, and putting patients first.

It’s time to make healthcare more affordable for Florida’s seniors and families.
Byron Donalds Live from the Villages nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1OGwblDNN…
Byron Donalds Live from the Villages nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1XxygmbEy…

Unreal operation. Proud of the courage and precision of our warfighters who brought an American hero home safely. 

Strong leadership from President Trump made it happen. 

We never leave our own behind. 🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸


The White House (@WhiteHouse)

WE WILL NEVER LEAVE AN AMERICAN WARFIGHTER BEHIND! 🇺🇸🇺🇸



— https://nitter.net/WhiteHouse/status/2040645870291440040#m

“He is not here, for He is risen.” 

Wishing everyone a happy and blessed Easter as we celebrate Christ’s victory over the grave and the new life we have through Him.

He is risen indeed!

It was an honor to meet with Bob’s Vets across the Tampa Bay area.

Grateful for their service and sacrifice in defending our nation, our values, and the American way of life. 🇺🇸

Today, we are reminded of the debt Christ paid on our behalf, giving His life so that in Him we might have life. 

"He was pierced for our transgressions, crushed for our iniquities, the punishment that brought us peace was on him, and by His wounds, we are healed." 

The debt we owed, He paid in full. The world's darkest day became our greatest hope.

Join me MONDAY, APRIL 6, at Hotel Eastport in The Villages as we kick off the Defending the Florida Dream Tour!

RSVP HERE: byrondonalds.com/affordabili…

Thank you to the Orlando Republican Women Federated for a great event! 

The reception across Central Florida has been amazing, and the momentum is real. Looking forward to being back soon! 🇺🇸🍊

It was great to be in Lake Mary for an incredible meet and greet with Sheriff Lemma at Lighthouse Seafood!

Thank you, Representatives @RachelPlakon and @ElectSmith28, for joining us, and to every patriot who packed the house.

Together, we will defend the Florida Dream!

Heartbroken to learn of the tragic loss of Vice Mayor Nancy Metayer Bowen. Praying for her family, loved ones, and the Coral Springs community during this devastating time. May justice be swift, and may her memory be a blessing.

From Florida’s Space Coast to the far side of the Moon—America is back, and Florida is center stage. Artemis lifts off and proves once again: no nation dreams bigger, builds bolder, or leads further.

Praying for a successful mission and safe return for our astronauts.
